en: A tinted photographic portrait of two smiling young women in close embrace, rendered in soft sepia tones with hand‑colored accents. One woman with wavy light hair faces the camera, resting her chin on her hand and showing a ring on her finger. The second woman stands just behind, cheek against the first, smiling gently. Their clothing is brightly hand‑tinted in vivid greens, pinks, reds, and yellows with a floral pattern. A small studio mark and number appear in white at the lower right.
